course.title: Surveying
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A line was measured with an engineering chain at a temperature of $2 5 . 0 ~ ^ { \circ } \mathsf { C }$ and pull of 9.50 kg. The measured length was 700 m. The temperature during measurement was 35.5 $^ { \circ } \mathsf { C }$ and the pull applied was 12.25 kg. Find the true length of the line, if the cross sectional area of the tape was $0 . 0 2 1 c m ^ { 2 }$ The coefficient of expansion of the material of the tape per ${ } ^ { \mathfrak { o } } \mathtt { C }$ is $3 . 5 \times 1 0 ^ { - 6 }$ and modulus of elasticity of the material of tape is $2 . 1 \times 1 0 ^ { 6 } k g / c m ^ { 2 }$

topics: Reconnaissance survey; Linear measurements; Traverse survey; Plane table survey; Levelling & contouring; Calculation of areas and volumes; Tachometry: Introduction, principles and problems on tachometry; Astronomical surveying: Definition, instruments, astronomical corrections, systems of time; Introduction of terrestrial photography, aerial photography, reading of photo mosaic, scale Project surveying; Errors in surveying; remote sensing; Introduction and application of global positioning system (GPS) and geographical information system (GIS), House setting.
_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
classification_notes: প্রশ্নটি জ্যামিতিক পরিমাপ এবং টেপের দৈর্ঘ্য নির্ণয় নিয়ে যা সিলেবাসের 'Linear measurements' ও 'Traverse survey'-এর অন্তর্ভুক্ত।
verification_notes: প্রশ্নটি টেপ মেজারমেন্টের তাপ ও টেনসন সংশোধনের সাথে সম্পর্কিত যা সত্যিই Linear measurements-এর অন্তর্ভুক্ত।
